text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training track at night is peaceful.
Just right for organizing one's thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, as I sat in the grandstand
working out tomorrow's training menu—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
Working... until this late...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer's job...
...is tough... isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While talking with Manhattan Cafe,
I suddenly heard the sound of footsteps running.
Looking around, there stood—

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She... is...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were amazing, Cafe-san,
training silently all by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The way she runs...
That is...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Faster... even faster...! 
I won't... lose sight of that back...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Earnest, desperate eyes.
That running style, as if pursuing an invisible "someone,"
looked just like—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Like me...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ Is she... also chasing after...
something...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But... ahead of her... there's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Alright, one more time.
I'm fine, totally fine! I can do this, I can do this!
I'm not tired at all, still got plenty—

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...? Ah... Cafe-san?!

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
! Um, if you don't mind,
would you like to run together today—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Who are you...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ? Yes?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Just who are you chasing after...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I can see no one in front of you...
Do you also have... a "friend"...
that only you can see...?

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uh... well...
Rather than a "friend"... it's, um.

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: C... Cafe-san is right there!

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Because you're the one I look up to, Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Your running... how should I put it,
I can feel such strong willpower in it...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I envied the "friend" being chased,
and seeing your back as you kept chasing after them...
made me want to chase after you too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...My... back...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So that I can one day definitely catch up
to your back as you keep challenging again and again...
I will never give up!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I never thought... there would be a horse girl...
chasing after my back...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Because I only looked ahead...
Because I only looked... at my "friend"...
all this time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It is a strange feeling...
To her, I am...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder.
I... do not know... but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The me who wants to catch up... and the me who is thought of...
as someone to catch up to...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I thought it would be nice... if I could run...
in a way worthy of that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...And also...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow... to the hospital...
I think I will go... visit her...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Since I have the chance... I would like to try running
with her in the flesh, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe bowed slightly,
and set off to run on the track
that had emptied without anyone noticing.
